questions.question: The student wants to compare the hardness of the three minerals. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Based on their Mohs scale numbers, diamond (10) is harder than quartz (7), and quartz is harder than fluorite (4). 正确选项 96% 选择
A mineral with a Mohs number of 10, like diamond, is harder than one with a Mohs number of 7, like quartz. 1% 选择
The Mohs scale of mineral hardness can be used to order quartz, fluorite, and diamond by their ability to scratch other minerals. 3% 选择
Diamond can leave visible scratches on fluorite, which is why diamond has a higher number than fluorite on the Mohs scale of mineral hardness.
